title: Inject right-now WIP reminder on agent compaction
description:
Inject a right-now WIP reminder into coding-agent compaction hooks so agents regain board awareness after context compaction without manual intervention.

## Product rule (Ryan 2026-09-09)

Compaction-hook injection = **whole-project WIP summary** (general board awareness), NOT pinned-issue scoped.

When an agent runs `kbs now` itself, it may scope to its own work for focused WIP.

Agents should be aware of both modes; compaction should be followed by whole-project WIP.
